svg.aria-label: A hand-drawn ladder of what developers pay per year, drawn as bars on the same scale. Sublime Text licence 2013: $70, once. PyCharm Professional 2015: $89 for the first year. ChatGPT Plus 2023: $20 a month, $240 a year. A $200 a month tier: $2,400 a year. A $300 a month tier: $3,600 a year. The last two bars run off the right-hand side compared with the first three, which are short stubs.
svg.text: WHAT A TOOL COSTS A YEAR
US prices, drawn to the same scale ($1,000 = the dashed line)
we used to deliberate over $70. now $2,400 barely gets a second look.
